title: Cone criterion: invariance of C under the dilation pull-backs ω ↦ λ⁻ⁿω(λ⁻¹·) gives IsConeCurrent C (unfolding η_{0,λ#})
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be a current on all of ℝ^P (GeometricCurrentOn univ n). Assume that for every λ > 0 and all test forms ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with ω'(y) = λ^{−n}·ω(λ^{−1}y) for every y ∈ ℝ^P, one has C(ω') = C(ω). Then C is a cone (IsConeCurrent C): currentEval(η_{0,λ#}C, ω) = C(ω) for every λ > 0 and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), where η_{0,λ#}C = blowUp C 0 λ is the push-forward of C by the dilation η_{0,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹y (Simon 6.2.23).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (lam⁻¹ • y)) → C ω' = C ω) → IsConeCurrent C
